findings.text: the head row of the fragment's measurement table records the head arm as "26932a19a working tree", which is the base revision, while gate-head.log's own header names revision b9196620c994 (head arm, committed tree) and the manifest's after_suite records b9196620c; the fragment therefore contradicts the log it cites, and a reader comparing the evidence table with the log cannot tell which revision the 33-passed result belongs to.

classify_tick is a standalone method that StationStore.tick (reckon/crew/station_store.py:365) never calls, so no runtime path reaches the reclassification this node adds: the station tick still only ingests pointers and streams. This matches the plan's sequencing, which gives the station process its loop in §7, but until that node lands the goal's subject ("the station tick reclassifies ...") is a capability that exists only under test.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when is the pytest gate in tests/test_the_station_classifies_only_what_moved.py over a three-run fleet with classify_pointer and the liveness probe counted through patches; the manifest's after_suite records gate-head.log '33 passed in 10.99s' EXIT=0 at b9196620c and baseline_suite records gate-base.log '24 passed in 5.90s' EXIT=0 at 26932a19a, so added_failure_count is 0, and negative-control.log ends EXIT=1 with all three declared mutations red.
